name: Corona Library and Community Services Teen Volunteers
org: City of Corona Community Services Department
what_you_do: Help at the Corona library. You can tutor kids, keep shelves neat, read to young kids, help with story time, help people use computers or work the summer reading table.
who_can_apply: Each role has its own age: Homework Helper 12 and up, Summer at Your Library Assistant 13 and up, Junior Page, Storyteller and Tech Coach 15 and up, Story Time Assistant 16 and up. Teen Club and the Book Cleaning Crew are for teens (Teen Club is grades 7 to 12). Everyone, even under 18, must pass a background check.
duration: Ongoing. Homework Helpers work Tuesdays and Thursdays, 3:30 to 5:30 pm, during the school year. Book Cleaning Crew works Saturdays before the library opens.
deadline_text: No deadline. Orientations are usually the third Monday of the month at 6:30 pm. The next one listed is Monday, Nov 16, 2026, at Circle City Center, 365 N. Main Street. The background check takes 4 to 6 weeks.
how_to_apply: Go to an orientation first. Then fill out the city volunteer form and pass the background check. Questions: Madelyne.Black@CoronaCA.gov.
notes: Only this city department takes volunteers under 18. It does not take court ordered or school discipline hours. One day events like cleanups and the Fourth of July parade are listed too. The library is at 650 South Main Street.
